note: Uniform convergence on K from the dense pointwise Cauchy property and the Lipschitz bound, and continuity of the limit, are carried. [L] measures lattice values at the nearest grid point instead of the interpolant with an O(a_N) vertex displacement, treats the interpolants separately in `held`, and states no periodicity of the limit.

lemma circulating : oscillation (NoHit C.S p n) (evaluate C e p v l):= by
  intro K hU hK ε hε
  obtain ⟨t,ht,hT⟩:= hK.exists_cthickening_subset_open (nohitOpen ..) hU
  obtain ⟨r,B,hr,hB,H⟩:= M.localLip v l p hT hK.cthickening
  let g:= min r (ε/(B+1))
  have hg: 0<g := lt_min hr (by positivity)
  have hv: 0<g/4:= by positivity
  refine ⟨g/4,hv,?_⟩
  filter_upwards [e.cofinal.eventually H,nearest (n:=n) (C:=C) e ht, nearest (n:=n) (C:=C) e hv] with i hi he hF x hx y hy hw
  let a:= C.S.a (e i); let f x := tag a (address a (x: Points n))
  have hl : f y∈ cthickening t K:= mem_cthickening_of_dist_le _ _ _ _ hy (he y).le
  have hz : dist (f x) (f y) < g := by
    have hv' := hF y; change dist (f y) y<g/4 at hv'; rw [dist_comm] at hv'
    have ht:=hF x; change dist (f x) x<_ at ht; linarith [dist_triangle (f x) x y, dist_triangle (f x) y (f y)]
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (hi _ _ hl (hz.le.trans (min_le_left ..))); change B*dist (f x) _ < _
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz.le hB); have hw:= (le_div_iff₀' (by positivity : 0 < B+1)).1 (min_le_right r (ε/(B+1)))
  change (B+1)*g ≤ ε at hw; linarith

proof_context.conclusion: The Lipschitz bound `localLip` makes the lattice values `evaluate C e p v l` equicontinuous (`oscillation`) on compacts of `NoHit C.S p n`, using nearest grid points via `address`.

lemma established (hp:Purchased C e):∃ f,Tuned C e p v [] f:= by
  exact growFrom (nohitOpen ..) (circulating M e p v []) (Cyclic C.S p n) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dense_of_ae (almostCyclic C.S p n)) (fun x hx=>hp _ _ _ x hx.1)

proof_context.conclusion: `growFrom` upgrades pointwise Cauchy at a dense set plus `oscillation` to `Tuned C e p v [] f`, i.e. `f` continuous on `NoHit` with locally uniform convergence.

theorem held {F:ℕ→Positions n→ℂ}{f:Points n→ℂ}(h:Cluster C e p n F f):
    Meets (NoHit C.S p n) (fun i=> interpolated C.S (e i) (F (e i))) f:=by
  refine ⟨h.1,fun K hx hK ε hε=>?_⟩
  suffices H:∀ j:Vertex n, ∀ᶠ i in atTop, ∀ x∈K, dist (F (e i) (vertex x (C.S.a (e i)) j)) (f x)≤ε/2 from
    (eventually_all.mpr H).mono (fun _ hi x hX=> (coinprice _ _ _ _ _ _ (fun i=>hi i _ hX)).trans_lt (half_lt_self hε))
  intro j; by_contra! ht
  choose s hs x hX hH using frequently_atTop.mp ht
  obtain ⟨y,hy,w,hw,hW⟩:= hK.tendsto_subseq hX
  let Y i:=x (w i); let g:=s ∘ w
  have hg:Tendsto g atTop atTop:=tendsto_atTop_mono (fun i=>hs (w i)) hw.tendsto_atTop
  let q i:= vertex (Y i) (C.S.a (e (g i))) j
  have hh:Tendsto (fun i=> tag (C.S.a (e (g i))) (q i)) atTop (𝓝 y):= hW.congr_dist (squeeze_zero (fun _=>dist_nonneg) (fun i=>(dist_comm ..).trans_le (surrounds _ _ (C.S.a_pos _))) (by simpa using! (((C.S.shrinks.comp e.cofinal).comp hg).const_mul (2*(4*(n:ℝ)):ℝ))))
  have hp:= (h.2 y (hx hy) q g hg hh).dist (((h.1.continuousAt ((nohitOpen ..).mem_nhds (hx hy))).tendsto).comp hW); rw [dist_self] at hp
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩:= (hp.eventually (ge_mem_nhds (half_pos hε))).exists; exact (hH (w i)).not_ge hi

proof_context.conclusion: Convergence along moving lattice points (`Cluster`) gives locally uniform convergence of the multilinear interpolants (`Meets`), using `coinprice` for the convex combination.
